name: up3x1
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on triple timeframe alignment, using three consecutive timeframes to confirm trend direction before entering trades. It opens positions when all three timeframe signals agree, aiming to capture strong directional moves with reduced false signals. The strategy employs systematic position sizing and risk management rules to control exposure.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于三重时间周期对齐的趋势跟踪策略，在三个连续时间周期确认趋势方向后才入场交易。当三个时间周期信号一致时开仓，旨在捕捉强方向性走势并减少虚假信号。策略采用系统化的仓位管理和资金管理规则来控制风险敞口。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是三重时间周期确认的趋势跟踪系统，通过在三个不同时间周期上验证趋势方向来过滤噪音信号。入场条件要求三个时间周期的趋势指标（通常是移动平均线或类似趋势判定工具）方向一致，只有当短、中、长三个周期全部看多或看空时才执行交易。出场条件依赖于趋势反转信号或止损/止盈设置，当任一时间周期趋势发生改变时可能触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户资金的百分比计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，EA可能使用固定的风险比例来计算仓位大小，但缺少动态调整机制如根据波动率调整仓位。整体策略逻辑清晰，多重时间周期过滤有效减少了震荡行情中的虚假信号，但在趋势转换期可能出现滞后入场的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a triple timeframe confirmation trend-following system that filters noise by validating trend direction across three different timeframes. Entry conditions require all three timeframe trend indicators (typically moving averages or similar trend determination tools) to align in the same direction, only executing trades when short, medium, and long-term periods all agree on bullish or bearish bias. Exit conditions rely on trend reversal signals or stop-loss/take-profit levels, with positions potentially closed when any timeframe trend changes direction. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations derived from account equity, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management employs a fixed risk ratio for position sizing but lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms such as volatility-based position scaling. The overall strategy logic is clear, with multi-timeframe filtering effectively reducing false signals in ranging markets, though lagging entries may occur during trend transition periods.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in pips, activates after price moves beyond this

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number to identify EA positions, 0 for all positions

pros: 三重时间周期确认有效过滤震荡市场的虚假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑清晰简洁，易于理解和维护，适合长期运行
趋势跟踪策略在强趋势行情中表现优异，盈亏比合理
pros_en: Triple timeframe confirmation effectively filters false signals in ranging markets, improving entry quality
Clear and concise strategy logic that is easy to understand and maintain, suitable for long-term operation
Trend-following strategy performs excellently in strong trending markets with reasonable risk-reward ratios
cons: 多重时间周期确认导致入场滞后，可能错过趋势初期的大段利润
在震荡市或横盘行情中可能频繁止损，连续亏损风险较高
缺乏波动率自适应机制，在不同市场波动环境下使用相同参数可能导致表现不稳定
cons_en: Multi-timeframe confirmation causes entry lag, potentially missing significant profits at trend inception
May experience frequent stop-outs in ranging or sideways markets, with high risk of consecutive losses
Lacks volatility-adaptive mechanism, using identical parameters across different market volatility environments may lead to inconsistent performance
improvements: 增加波动率自适应机制，根据ATR动态调整止损止盈和仓位大小
加入震荡行情识别过滤器，在横盘市场减少交易频率或暂停交易
优化时间周期权重，允许不同时间周期信号具有不同影响力权重
improvements_en: Add volatility-adaptive mechanism using ATR to dynamically adjust stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing
Incorporate ranging market identification filter to reduce trade frequency or pause trading during sideways markets
Optimize timeframe weighting to allow different timeframes to carry varying influence weights on the final signal

risk_points: 三重确认滞后入场可能导致止损后趋势已近尾声，盈亏比恶化
缺乏最大回撤控制和日亏损限额，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
risk_points_en: Triple confirmation lagging entry may cause stop-losses when trends are nearly exhausted, worsening risk-reward ratio
Lacks maximum drawdown control and daily loss limits, potentially suffering significant losses in extreme market conditions
Fixed stop-loss does not account for market volatility changes, being too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility environments
